# Platfer

Platfer is an education and coaching platform for teachers, coaching institutes and students in India.

- https://platfer.in/student-messaging-community.html — Student messaging community on Platfer

## Product
Platfer provides live classes, recorded lectures, Smart Board, Notes + Voice, online tests, attendance, fees management, student records, batches, announcements, messaging, Communities, coaching profiles and student coaching discovery. Teachers can use the teacher platform free; students can join relevant coaching batches using Batch Codes and use learning features.

## Official Android app
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.platfer.app

- [Blog: Tonight, a Student in Your City Is Searching for a Coaching]https://platfer.in/blog/students-searching-coaching-in-your-city): Platfer blog post — how students find and shortlist a coaching in their city today (city first, then subject, class, budget), and the five profile fixes that get a coaching onto the list students find.

- [Blog: How to Choose the Right Location for Your Coaching Centre](https://platfer.in/blog/choose-right-location-for-coaching-centre): Platfer blog post — how to choose the right location for your coaching centre — walk the lanes students already use, pay a rent the first batch can carry, and take the small room that fills over the big hall that echoes.
- [Blog: How to Welcome a New Student Into a Batch That Started Months Ago](https://platfer.in/blog/welcome-new-student-into-batch-started-months-ago): Platfer blog post — how to welcome a new student into a batch that started months ago — plan the first day, catch up on the two or three ideas the current chapter needs, seat the child inside the batch, and tell the parent the truth with a date for the next call.
- [Blog: What to Do When the Whole Batch Fails One Test](https://platfer.in/blog/whole-batch-fails-one-test-what-to-do): Platfer blog post — what to do when the whole batch fails one test — read the paper before the marks, tell the batch the truth once and calmly, fix the gap instead of the marks, and make the next test fair.
- [Blog: How to Handle a Parent Who Wants You to Guarantee Marks](https://platfer.in/blog/parent-wants-guarantee-of-marks): Platfer blog post — how to handle a parent who wants you to guarantee marks — never promise a number, promise the work instead, make the promise checkable, and let the parent watch the progress for a month.
- [Blog: How to Plan Your Admission Season So Your Batches Fill Before the Session Starts](https://platfer.in/blog/plan-admission-season-fill-batches-before-session): Platfer blog post — how to plan your admission season so your batches fill before the session starts — start two months early, keep last year’s students, make joining take ten minutes, and treat the first week as the last week of admissions.
- [Blog: What to Do When a Rival Coaching Opens Next Door](https://platfer.in/blog/rival-coaching-opens-next-door-what-to-do): Platfer blog post — what to do when a rival coaching opens next door — stay calm the first week, talk to students and parents before the rival does, fix the one weakness it will point at, and never fight a fee war.
- [Blog: How to Turn Your Home Tuition Students Into a Full Batch](https://platfer.in/blog/turn-home-tuition-students-into-batch): Platfer blog post — how to turn home tuition students into a full batch — start with a small group of six to eight at the same level, price it between tuition and a big coaching, and keep personal attention built into the routine.
- [Blog: The Week Before Board Exams: How to Keep Your Batch Calm and Ready](https://platfer.in/blog/exam-week-before-boards-keep-batch-calm-ready): Platfer blog post — the week before board exams — stop teaching new topics, give each day a shape with a short morning test, protect sleep and routine, and tell parents the plan once instead of answering panic calls all week.
- [Blog: How to Teach One Batch Online and Offline Without Doubling Your Work](https://platfer.in/blog/teach-one-batch-online-and-offline-without-double-work): Platfer blog post — how to teach one batch online and offline without doubling your work — one plan, one pace, one test for both groups, recordings that keep stragglers in step, and a single attendance list.
